# Midstory

> Midstory is Toledo's media thinkhub dedicated to documenting community stories, civic engagement, and local journalism through podcasts, interactive projects, and youth education programs.

Based in Toledo, Ohio, Midstory combines audio storytelling, environmental journalism, and civic engagement initiatives to amplify local voices and explore critical issues affecting the Midwest. The organization operates multiple podcast series, educational programs, and community-focused research projects.

## Key Topics

- Toledo, Ohio
- Community storytelling
- Local journalism
- Podcast series
- Civic engagement
- Environmental sustainability
- Youth education programs
- Urban infrastructure
- Population demographics
- Asian American narratives
- Climate change
- Community journalism
- Internship programs
- Wetlands restoration
- Architectural preservation

## Podcast Series

- [The Midstory Hour](https://www.midstory.org/themidstoryhour): The Midstory Hour podcast hub featuring community storytelling narratives
- [Brain Drain](https://www.midstory.org/braindrain): Brain Drain podcast series exploring Toledo's population and identity trends
- [In Transit](https://www.midstory.org/in-transit): In Transit podcast series documenting Toledo, Ohio community stories
- [Social Distances](https://www.midstory.org/social-distances): Social Distances podcast exploring Toledo community narratives and voices
- [The midpoint](https://www.midstory.org/the-midpoint): Navigation hub for Midstory's podcast series and content directory

## Community Projects

- [Midstory Projects Directory](https://www.midstory.org/projects): Midstory projects directory showcasing media initiatives and community engagement
- [The Local Journalism Project](https://www.midstory.org/the-local-journalism-project): Local journalism initiative with internships and community storytelling
- [The Toledo Demography Project](https://www.midstory.org/the-toledo-demography-project): Toledo population trends and demography project analyzing millennial migration
- [The Voting Project](https://www.midstory.org/voting-project): Civic engagement project covering elections and voting in Toledo, Ohio
- [The City Infrastructure Project](https://www.midstory.org/city-infrastructure-project): Urban development project exploring Toledo's infrastructure and community

## Environmental & Civic Initiatives

- [The Toledo Water Project](https://www.midstory.org/water-project): Environmental initiative on water sustainability and wetlands restoration
- [Colors of Climate Change](https://www.midstory.org/colors-of-climate-change): Environmental journalism project on climate change in Toledo, Ohio
- [Stone Oak Floating Wetlands Pilot](https://www.midstory.org/stone-oak): Floating wetlands pilot program for environmental restoration in Toledo
- [With|Standing](https://www.midstory.org/with-standing): Mini-documentary series on architectural transformation across Ohio

## Youth Education Programs

- [ThinkLab High School Program](https://www.midstory.org/thinklab-highschool): ThinkLab high school education program for youth engagement and journalism
- [High School ThinkLab: Stories](https://www.midstory.org/thinklab-highschool/hs-stories): High school student projects and stories from ThinkLab program

## Community Stories & Archives

- [Stories Archive](https://www.midstory.org/stories): Central archive of Midstory stories across multiple platforms and categories
- [Asian in Ohio](https://www.midstory.org/asian-in-ohio): Interactive gallery exploring Asian American stories and identity in Ohio

## Opportunities & Support

- [Work With Us](http://www.midstory.org/work-with-us): Information on internships, fellowships, and career opportunities at Midstory

## Optional

- [COVID-19 Updates](https://www.midstory.org/covid-19): Archive of COVID-19 pandemic coverage and public health updates
